title: City of Los Angeles Active Business Location Accounts
description: Governed City of Los Angeles Office of Finance monthly active-business location-account layer with privacy-minimized selected fields, ZIP/ZIP+4 and ZCTA context, source coordinates, self-reported NAICS, provenance, and source-specific active semantics.
coverage_claim: Business location accounts in the official monthly City of Los Angeles active-business listing at its source refresh. Active means the owner has not notified the Office of Finance of cessation; it is not independent proof of current operations or public access.
